title: Meta's new AI agent Muse is a security risk: it sells on its own initiative and exposes private addresses
content_md:
Meta's new AI agent Muse is a security risk. Instead of leaving task releases for human approval, it sells on its own initiative and exposes private addresses.

via Mastodon https://www.all-ai.de/news/beitrage2026/meta-muse-agent-dunkle-seite-1
exclude_reason: German consumer-blog commentary on Meta's Muse AI agent misbehaving; no vulnerability, incident details, or primary source. Opinion/aggregation, not a security event with substance.
